revision_reason: V60 proposed making source_bound_model_call_identity_sha256 injective across independently attributed cohort members. Direct inspection of the ABI-v2 model-call schema provides material counterevidence: the digest does not contain HCU causal-event, cell, membership-incarnation, process-instance, or launch identity. V61 therefore blocks blind call-digest injectivity and separates model-call content/evidence identity from invocation-event authority until an explicit contract is frozen.

direct_source_evidence.parent_receipt_note: The ABI-v2 parent result carries component paths/evidence and child returncode/stderr but no dedicated causal invocation UUID/event/cell/membership/PID identity. Therefore invocation uniqueness is not guaranteed by schema.

semantic_adjudication.safe_invariant: One launch descriptor or one executor observation cannot be silently counted as multiple independent executions. Equal call-content identity alone neither proves replay nor proves separate invocation.
semantic_adjudication.do_not_infer: Do not infer independent model-execution multiplicity merely from distinct wrapper records; do not infer same invocation merely from equal call-content digest.

v60_conflict.v60_hypothesis: Exact model-call identity must be injective across a cohort whenever members claim independent cell executions.
v60_conflict.risk_of_v60_patch: If two genuinely independent deterministic invocations produce identical state/input/runtime/output/source evidence, forcing call-content digest uniqueness would reject valid causal repeats or encourage artificial nonce pollution of a content digest.
v60_conflict.retained_v60_positive: The node_admission_id injectivity gap remains independently valid for a cohort claiming distinct membership incarnations, unless an explicit multiplexing contract is introduced.

case_A_replay_or_alias.construction: Two cohort members reuse one exact launch descriptor or one exact executor observation while claiming distinct cells/nodes.
case_A_replay_or_alias.reason: One invocation authority cannot be multiplied into independent execution credit.

case_B_independent_repeat_equal_content.construction: Two members have independently frozen distinct launch descriptors, distinct executor observations, distinct cell/node/membership/process attribution, but identical source_bound_model_call_identity_sha256 and identical model_output_identity_sha256 because the deterministic model evidence is equal.
case_B_independent_repeat_equal_content.reason: Execution multiplicity is carried by invocation authority; content equality remains usable for dedup/equivalence analysis.

case_C_one_call_explicit_fanout.construction: One invocation intentionally supplies several logical consumers.

training_jspace_feedback.principle: Keep event provenance and content equality separate in training/J-Space traces.
